verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Bolt's support site serves a valid llms.txt file (HTTP 200) listing structured links to its docs, and the docs themselves are exposed in clean .md format suitable for agent consumption. This is concrete first-party evidence the capability works as claimed, not just a vendor claim. Missing for 10: no independent/community report of an agent actually consuming llms.txt in practice, and no evidence of additional agent-specific manifest formats beyond llms.txt.
